notes.title: New level: Cave and other updates
notes.content:
The following updates/improvements have been made:


 The cave now has its own level!
 Added sound as damage for fire, wolf and kraken.
 Adjusted collision merchant
 Adjusted collision quest in the tavern 
 Day: approx. 40 minutes and night approx. 10 minutes real time
 Small igloo village created
 Various translation errors corrected
 Changed the ‘heart symbol’ at the hospital
 Added the first animation sounds for the game character
 Intro changed
 New building in the village nest: Shed
 Pickaxe must be picked up, otherwise you can't mine stones
 Torch cannot be used in water, goes out
 Animation ship, end of game added
 New item pickaxe, can now be bought from the merchant.
 3 new quests
 Various editorial changes
 Player takes damage when not wearing clothes.
 Various quest bugs fixed


Price adjustments
As the game has now grown further, the price has been raised to (EUR) 8.99.

notes.title: Update 0.4ea
notes.content:
We have made a small update with the following changes:


The stomach now growls louder
The penguins that wander now also "quack"
Removed door at the hospital
Rotten food can now be sold for 1 bronze at the merchant
Quest activation for "Die Seen" made clearer
Dialogue button made wider
Various editorial improvements (including translations)
Penguin "Claudia" slightly moved
Quest info in the margin improved/corrected
Bed widget changed to sleep/get up
When the clothes are picked up, no further function appears to pick up the clothes again. The function had hung up here.

notes.title: Update 0.3ea
notes.content:
The following changes have been made to the version. We have also implemented wishes, tips and ideas from you:


 Animation removed from the crates
 Editorial adjustments & translations
 Penguins make "noises" when you speak to them
 Various trigger boxes moved/adjusted
 The stomach now growls when you are hungry
 Compass made smaller
 Changed the dialogue cam for the nurse
 Item nails added
 Door collision changed
 In-game menu can now be closed with ESC
 A message now appears when you start a new game. So that you don't accidentally start a completely new game and overwrite the memory.
 Dialogue circle Fade in and Out
 Quest description "Choose a reward" changed to "Reward"
 Removed penguin carriage in Pingurama
 Otto dialogue changed (for clothing)
 Clothes are now already available in the nest
 House in the nest enlarged/changed
 "Polarhöhle" sign better illuminated in the dark
 Penguin "Claudia" moved due to quest
 There is now also a cooking option in the Schneeflockendorf


Have you discovered ideas, comments and bugs in the game? Then feel free to use the forum on Steam or come to our Discord channel (https://discord.gg/eUmYUbBdmX)

notes.title: Language Update: We speak English now!
notes.content:
We have added the English language to the game. 

The following languages can now be selected:

German
English


There are also the following changes:

Game main intro adapted with English and logo ‘Division Software’
Dialogue penguin with the hint of the save function removed, since autosave is available
Moved the barkeeper in the tavern further to the left (you can now open the door better)
Dialogue texts (German): Editorial changes/corrections
